subject.title: fix(telegram): harden rich send fallback and typing breaker

question: Should this PR land with Telegram's scoped five-consecutive-failure typing breaker, or should the typing part use a different Telegram-owned threshold or decay policy before merge?
rationale: The linked issue proposed a threshold increase or decay behavior, and the PR now avoids changing the shared default but still chooses a concrete Telegram policy without maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Accept scoped five-failure tolerance
options.body: Merge the Telegram-owned threshold after the proof gate is satisfied because it fixes the reported quiet-mid-turn behavior without changing other channels.

options.title: Request a different typing policy
options.body: Ask the contributor to replace the fixed threshold with a decay/reset policy or a different Telegram-owned constant before merge.

options.title: Split typing from rich-send fallback
options.body: Land only the rich-send reliability fix first and leave Telegram typing tolerance on the linked issue for a separate maintainer decision.

recommendation.title: Accept scoped five-failure tolerance
recommendation.body: Merge the Telegram-owned threshold after the proof gate is satisfied because it fixes the reported quiet-mid-turn behavior without changing other channels.
